scope: Independent read-only audit of raw Yahoo data, normalization, Solidity replay harness and all 3009 logged snapshots. No signing, broadcast, or mutation of prior evidence. Only this review artifact is written.
method: Standalone Decimal/integer calculations from raw source and raw Forge logs. No imports of or calls to the normalizer or exporter formulas. Solidity reviewed for oracle execution order, actual treasury cashflow assertions and account coverage.

dataReview.sourceTimestamps: All 1003 timestamps are 09:30 America/New_York session-open labels; not availability times of the close.
dataReview.split: 2022-08-25 3:1; inputs already adjusted, no second division or holdings multiplication.
dataReview.precision: 8 decimal places HALF_EVEN; E18 encodes exact rounded value.
dataReview.periodDefinition: Each year first observed Close to last observed Close; independent reset, not standard previous-year-end annual return or chained four-year return.

formulas.dailyBuybackOracleUsdgValueRaw: floor(actualStockSpentRaw * historicalPriceE18 / 1e30), then summed across days; monetary mark, not actual USDG spent
formulas.maximumDailyDrawdownPercent: max over daily rows of 100 * (running prior-or-current peak - current value) / running peak
formulas.independentFunPriceCrosscheck: floor(lpStockRaw * 1e18 / lpFunRaw) agrees with emitted marginal FUN/STOCK price within 1 unit of E18 encoding; full-range principal holdings omit accrued fees.
formulas.independentBuybackStockFlow: LP principal STOCK change equals floor(actualStockSpentRaw * 997 / 1000), within -1..0 wei of round-down conversion. The harness separately asserts actual treasury balance decrease equals returned spend.
formulas.independentBuybackFunFlow: LP principal FUN decrease equals daily burn plus keeper FUN increase, within 0..1 wei of round-down conversion.

sourceReview.dailyInputOrdering: Price is known then held 601 synthetic seconds, poke updates the observation, health verified, at most one execute then one buyback. No future bar consulted.
sourceReview.fixedDepthProof: After replacing original seeded position, original/new position liquidity and active liquidity match. Final harness asserts active V3 liquidity after every price move and at end of every sample after keeper operations; all 3009 log values equal initial L.
sourceReview.fixedDepthFinding: Initial harness only checked active L at fixture setup. Independent review identified possible inactive LP crossing. Final a44b5a2e harness adds full-path assertion and per-row L; rerun preserves every economic row, excludes only harness gas and added L field.
sourceReview.accountingAssertions: Actual treasury stock buckets sum to balance; tracked FUN holder/curve/manager/hook/keeper/treasury/factory balances sum to supply; holder FUN unchanged; router FUN/STOCK/USDG zero. These unlogged accounts are source assertions in 12 passing tests, not separately reconstructed from raw snapshots.
sourceReview.sourceHashStatus: final expected source and log hashes verified

limitations: Historical daily Close inputs do not constitute historical chain or market execution; current deployed contracts and artificial test-asset minting are used.
Same V3 L is counterfactual depth, not historical liquidity or equal total capital after widening the LP range. External market-maker/price-setting P&L and costs are excluded.

Close is available only after the session. The 601-second constant-price hold, synthetic calendar-day timing and forced-open market are explicit assumptions, not observed tradability; DST, holidays, early closes and intraday paths are absent.
One execute and one buyback attempt per noninitial day may leave further actions due. Daily samples cannot validate intraday 1-bp triggering, ordering, delay or execution frequency.
No external FUN user flow or adversarial trades in this replay. Marginal FUN and LP marks are not executable full-position liquidation proceeds.
Treasury NAV excludes spent buyback stock; buyback marks are not investment distributions. Neither NAV change nor NAV plus buyback marks is investor total return.
Unclaimed curve fees and LP accrued fees are separate from treasury cash and LP principal. Gasleft-based harness estimates exclude intrinsic gas and are not deducted as paid costs.
Three groups reset at every year first close. Source prices use already-split-adjusted share units, avoiding any duplicate split application.

exportCrosscheck.humanReport: Four dated windows and all 20 rounded percentage cells match independent calculations; 2023 keeper500 two take-profit dates confirmed; methodological boundaries reviewed.

findings.title: Fixed V3 liquidity assertion did not originally cover the full historical path
findings.resolution: Final harness asserts V3 active liquidity after every price move and after keeper operations; every snapshot records identical L. The prior successful log remains preserved, and all economic fields agree with the rerun.
